## Gemini 4 Carbon API

Gemini 4 Carbon is a large language model by Google, available on the Venice API as `gemini-4-carbon`. The provider of this model may retain prompt data (though it is anonymized by Venice). For sensitive content, use a private model.

Gemini 4 Carbon is Google's frontier model for long-horizon agentic work across software engineering, scientific reasoning, and cybersecurity defense, with a unified 1M token context window and deeper tunable thinking than Gemini 4 Argon.

### Gemini 4 Carbon API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gemini-4-carbon` | Standard | Anonymized | $2.50 / $12.50 per 1M |

### Gemini 4 Carbon specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Google |
| Released | Nov 10, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Context window | 1M tokens |
| Max output | 64K tokens |

| [GPQA Diamond](/models/methodology#benchmarks) | 95.5% ±2.9 (95% interval), run by Venice through the API at its default reasoning on Nov 20, 2026 |
| [Live speed and uptime](/models/methodology#machine-readable-data) | https://metrics.venice.ai/v1/models/gemini-4-carbon.json, refreshed every 5 minutes |

### How to use the Gemini 4 Carbon API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "gemini-4-carbon"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gemini-4-carbon",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }],
    "reasoning_effort": "medium"
  }'
```
